contacts.name: James Chen
contacts.message:
Hi James,

I'm reaching out from Flextail — we make portable power stations (500W-1500W) with LiFePO4 batteries, designed for outdoor enthusiasts.

We've been working with major US retailers and are looking to expand our presence at Bass Pro Shops.

Would love to discuss how we can bring value to your outdoor power category.

Best,
David
